title: Holomorphically parallelizable solvmanifolds with special metrics and their deformations
summary: We investigate the existence of strong Kähler with torsion metrics along deformations of the Iwasawa manifold and of the holomorphically parallelizable Nakamura manifold. We also show that the class of deformations of the holomorphically parallelizable Nakamura manifold yielding a non-left-invariant complex structure admits a balanced metric but does not admit any strong Kähler with torsion metric.
